description: Smart Meter Penetration by Transformer Level is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Smart Meter Penetration by Transformer Level " data table provides aggregated information giving the percentage of Smart Meter penetration (also broken down by Smart Meter Type i.e. SMETS1 or SMETS2) by LV Transformer. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Asset Data. Its keywords are SPM, SPD, Smart Meter, Transformer. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
